entries.source: Monumenta Boica. 43 = Collectio nova 16, Monumenta Episcopatus Wirziburgensis
entries.summary: Friedmann Zobel vertauscht mit Einwilligung seiner Frau Katherina mit seinem Bruder Dietzel Güter zu Essfeld und Wolkshausen.
entries.german:
Jn gotes nomen amen.
Jch Frideman Zobel vnd Katherin von Rosenberg min
eliche wirtin bekenne vnd thun kunt offelichen an disem brief fur
vns vnd alle vnder erben, daz wir ein slehten guten wehssel thun
vnd gethan haben zu rehtter vrtet mit vnsern gůeten die wir haben
zu Eygzfelt, zu den zitten haben inn gehabt Sicze Rysener
vnd Heincz Schuwurt: die haben wir geben Diezeln Zobeln
min bruder vmb andreu gůt die gelegen sin zu Wolkzhůsen.
Also gebe wir mit gesamtter hant im die gůt vf mit allen vellen
vnd zu gehorde in aller der moz vnd weyse alz wir die gůt ge-
habt haben biz her, also gebe wir si im vff mit munde mit halm
alz sitlichen vnd gewonlichen ist in dem lande zu Francken.
Auch gibe ich im die wart die ich han vf den vorgenanten
gueten noch minner swester tott: waz mir denne solt werden ader
moht von ir zu teil, do sol er reht zu haben alz ich angeverde.
Auch geloben wir fur vns vnd alle vnder erben, den vor-
genanten wehssel fehst vnd stet zu halten, vnd da wyder niht zu
thůn, noch nieman gestaten der do wyder thun wolt, ez wer mit
geriht geistlich oder wertlichen, an allez geverde.
Vnd dez zu vrkunde der ganczer worheit so han ich vor-
genanter Fridmaa Zobel vnd min eliche wirtin vnderew beyde
jnsygel gehangen an dysen brief, der geben ist nach gocz geburt
dreuczehenhundert jar dar nach in dem dreu vnd ahczigestem jar,
an dem nehsten samztag vor sant Peters tag czu sunwenden.
entries.english: In God's name, amen. I, Friedmann Zobel, and Katherin von Rosenberg, my lawful wife, acknowledge and make publicly known by this letter, for ourselves and all our heirs, that we have made and concluded a fair, good exchange, by proper [?] judgment, of our goods which we have at Essfeld, which at that time were held by Sicze Rysener and Heinrich Schuwurt. We have given these to Dietzel Zobel, my brother, in exchange for other goods located at Wolkshausen. Thus we, with joint hand, convey to him the goods with all their income and appurtenances, in every manner and way as we have held the goods until now; thus we convey them to him by mouth and with the straw, as is customary and usual in the land of Franconia. Also I give him the reversion that I have on the aforementioned goods after my sister's death: whatever share might then come to me from her, he shall have the right to it, as I do, without fraud. Also we promise, for ourselves and all our heirs, to keep the aforementioned exchange firmly and steadily, not to act against it, and not to allow anyone to do so who might wish to, whether by ecclesiastical or secular court, without fraud. And in witness of the whole truth, I, the aforementioned Friedmann Zobel, and my lawful wife have both hung our seals on this letter, which was given in the year thirteen hundred and eighty-three, on the nearest Saturday before St. Peter's day at the solstice.

facts.content: exchanged goods at Essfeld with his brother Dietzel Zobel for goods at Wolkshausen, jointly with his wife Katharina von Rosenberg.

entries.german: Frideman Zobel und seine Ehewirthin Katherin von Rosenberg vertauschen ihre Güter zu Eygzfelt an Diez Zobel des vorgenannten Bruder gegen etliche Güter zu Wolkzhusen. G. am Samztag vor Peters Tag zu Sunwenden. (c. 2 S.)
entries.english: Frideman Zobel and his wife Katherin von Rosenberg exchange their goods at Eygzfelt with Diez Zobel, brother of the aforementioned, for certain goods at Wolkzhusen. Given on the Saturday before St. Peter's day at the solstice. (With 2 seals.)

facts.content: exchanged goods at Eygzfelt with Diez Zobel for goods at Wolkzhusen, jointly with her husband Frideman Zobel.
